   --  continuous; a nonempty non-continuous Mat (gapped Region or Slice)
   --  raises OpenCV_Error before Process is invoked. A shallow Mat lease
   --  keeps storage alive for the callback (memory management, not thread
   --  synchronization). Do not retain a reference or address of Data after
   --  Process returns.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float16 four-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except writes through Data mutate the Mat
   --  storage immediately. Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged;
   --  completed writes remain visible.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float16 four-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of four-channel pixels supplied by the caller. Its index
   --  bounds are the caller's choice: only Data'First (the first pixel) and
   --  Data'Length (the capacity, counted in pixels) are used.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float16_Vec4.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed CV_16FC4 Mat that
   --  aliases Data. Image (Row, Column) is
   --  Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column). Writes through Image
   --  immediately modify Data and vice versa.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image, within the native signed
   --  32-bit range.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image, within the native
   --  signed 32-bit range.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed N-dimensional
   --  CV_16FC4 Mat that aliases Data, with the final dimension varying
   --  fastest. Shape iteration order maps to OpenCV dimension order
   --  regardless of Shape'First.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length, in pixels, must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16FC4 Mat that aliases
   --  Data with Row_Stride complete pixels between logical row starts.
   --  Image (Row, Column) maps to Data (Data'First + Row * Row_Stride +
   --  Column). Padding and extra trailing storage are outside the logical
   --  Mat.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between the starts of
   --  consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   :
        not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable strided N-dimensional
   --  CV_16FC4 Mat that aliases Data. Strides supplies exactly one stride
   --  per dimension in the same order as Shape, counted in complete pixels.
   --  The final stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested
   --  inner block: Strides (I) >= Strides (I + 1) * Shape (I + 1).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels (not
   --  scalar channels, not bytes); the final stride must be 1 and each outer
   --  stride must cover its nested inner block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, the two arrays differ in length, or Data
   --  is too short.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed row-major buffer; geometry and capacity
   --  match the writable Rows/Columns overload. Data may be an aliased
   --  constant, and the mode-in Image prevents normal Ada mutation.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length, in pixels, must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed N-dimensional buffer, with the geometry
   --  rules of the writable N-dimensional overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases; it may
   --  be an aliased constant.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  is invalid, has more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, or
   --  Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a two-dimensional buffer with Row_Stride complete
   --  pixels between row starts, following the rules of the writable
   --  strided overload. Padding between rows is not part of the logical Mat.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length, in pixels, must be at least
   --  Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between row starts; at
   --  least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is too short, or a dimension
   --  exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a strided N-dimensional buffer, following the
   --  geometry, stride and capacity rules of the writable strided
   --  N-dimensional overload. Strides count complete pixels.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length, in pixels, must be at least
   --  Shape (first) * Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, or Data is too short.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: Row_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  The pixels of one Mat row, one Vector (four interleaved channel
   --  values) per column. Array bounds are the caller's choice: only the
   --  length matters, and the first array element always corresponds to
   --  column 0.
   type Row_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float16_Vec4.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: Read_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies one row of Image into Data, keeping the exact binary16 bits of
   --  every channel. Data'Length must equal Image.Columns. Image is
   --  unchanged and Data owns its values.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data Receives one four-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float16 four-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs
   --  from Image.Columns.
   procedure Read_Row (Image : Mat; Row : Natural; Data : out Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: Write_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies Data into one row of Image, keeping the exact binary16 bits of
   --  every channel. Data'Length must equal Image.Columns. The values are
   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One four-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float16 four-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs
   --  from Image.Columns.
   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of one Float16 C4 Mat row. Data
   --  aliases the native storage of that row; no pixel values are copied.
   --  Only the active row elements are exposed, never inter-row padding.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row. Data is valid
   --  only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Float16 four-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Row
     (Image   : Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: With_Writable_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Row, except Process receives an in-out view. Writes
   --  through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Float16 four-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Writable_Row
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.name: Float32_Classification
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.signature:
--  Result of classifying one stored Float32 element.
   --  @enum Finite The value is neither an infinity nor a NaN; zeros and
   --  subnormals are finite.
   --  @enum Positive_Infinity The value is positive infinity.
   --  @enum Negative_Infinity The value is negative infinity.
   --  @enum Not_A_Number The value is a NaN of any sign or payload.
   type Float32_Classification is
     (Finite, Positive_Infinity, Negative_Infinity, Not_A_Number);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.signature:
--  Reads the element at a zero-based row and column of a two-dimensional
   --  Mat.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The stored element value.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  single-channel Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return Float32_Value;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.name: Classify
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.signature:
--  Classifies the stored Float32 value without converting non-finite IEEE
   --  values into the public Float32_Value subtype.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return Finite, Positive_Infinity, Negative_Infinity or Not_A_Number
   --  for the stored element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  single-channel Mat, Row or Column is outside the Mat, or the native
   --  classification fails.
   function Classify
     (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return Float32_Classification;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.signature:
--  Writes the element at a zero-based row and column of a two-dimensional
   --  Mat. The change is made in the Mat's actual storage and is visible
   --  through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @param Value The element value to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  single-channel Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Row, Column : Integer; Value : Float32_Value);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional access. Indices'Length must equal
   --  Image.Dimension_Count. Iteration order maps to OpenCV dimensions
   --  regardless of the array's index bounds.
   --  @param Image A Float32 Mat with exactly one channel and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The stored element value.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  single-channel Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per
   --  dimension, or an index is out of range.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return Float32_Value;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write; the indexing rules of the matching Get
   --  apply. The change is made in the Mat's actual storage and is visible
   --  through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A Float32 Mat with exactly one channel and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The element value to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  single-channel Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per
   --  dimension, or an index is out of range.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Indices : Index_Array; Value : Float32_Value);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Buffer_Access.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  The flat element buffer of a Mat: one Float32_Value per Mat element, in
   --  OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying fastest. The
   --  callbacks pass arrays whose bounds are 0 .. Natural (Image.Total) - 1.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float32_Value;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of a continuous Float32 C1
   --  Mat of any dimension count; genuine N-D Mats are supported.
   --  Data directly aliases native OpenCV storage for the entire
   --  logical buffer; no pixel values are copied. The explicitly
   --  aliased callback formal guarantees that Data is passed by
   --  reference and directly denotes the borrowed Mat for the duration
   --  of Process. The ordinary lifetime of the view is the callback.
   --  Data is one flat zero-based array of Mat elements in OpenCV
   --  element order, final dimension varying fastest:
   --  Data'First = 0, Data'Last = Natural (Image.Total) - 1, and
   --  Data'Length = Natural (Image.Total). For Shape (D1, ..., Dn),
   --  zero-based index (I1, ..., In) is Data offset
   --  ((I1 * D2 + I2) * D3 + ...) * Dn + In. For a 2-D Mat, element
   --  Data (Row * Image.Columns + Column) denotes Image (Row, Column).
   --  There are no row separators, padding, or gaps. Image must be
   --  continuous (Is_Continuous); a nonempty non-continuous Mat, such
   --  as a gapped Region or Slice, raises OpenCV_Error before Process
   --  is invoked. A continuous Region or N-D Slice is accepted even
   --  when it is a submatrix. The implementation holds one shallow Mat
   --  lease for the callback so referenced storage cannot disappear
   --  merely because another header is rebound or finalized. That lease
   --  is deterministic memory management, not thread synchronization.
   --  Do not retain a reference or address of Data after Process
   --  returns. Read-only access performs no copy; if another alias
   --  mutates the shared storage during the callback, Data observes
   --  those changes according to ordinary aliasing rules.
   --  An empty Mat is accepted, and Process then receives an empty Data.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float32 single-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except Process receives an in-out view.
   --  Writes through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  There is no write-back phase. A write through Data is visible
   --  through Image and any shallow alias before Process returns, and
   --  a write through another alias is immediately visible through
   --  Data. Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged; any
   --  writes completed before the exception remain visible.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float32 single-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of Float32_Value elements supplied by the caller. Its
   --  index bounds are the caller's choice: only Data'First (the first
   --  element) and Data'Length (the capacity) are used, and the lower bound
   --  is not exposed through the Mat.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float32_Value;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable Mat that aliases Data.
   --  Image (0, 0) is Data (Data'First) and row-major element Image
   --  (Row, Column) is Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column).
   --  Data'Length must equal Rows * Columns. The Ada lower bound is
   --  not exposed through the Mat. Image is valid only during Process
   --  and must not be retained. Ordinary shallow copies and views are
   --  rejected because they would share the caller-owned buffer after
   --  Process returns. Clone is the supported way to keep an
   --  independent Mat. Writes through Image immediately modify Data,
   --  and writes through Data immediately affect Image. The temporary
   --  cv::Mat header does not own Data and does not copy it. The aliased
   --  formal passes Data by reference, so Image denotes caller-owned storage.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image, within the native signed
   --  32-bit range.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image, within the native
   --  signed 32-bit range.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows    : Positive;
      Columns : Positive;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed N-dimensional
   --  CV_32FC1 Mat that aliases Data. Shape'Length must be in 2 .. 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) and
   --  every extent must be positive; Shape iteration order maps directly to
   --  OpenCV dimension order regardless of Shape'First. Data'Length must
   --  equal product (Shape) exactly. Storage is packed and continuous with
   --  the final dimension varying fastest: zero-based index (I1, .., In)
   --  is Data (Data'First + ((I1 * D2 + I2) * D3 + ..) * Dn + In). Neither
   --  Ada lower bound is exposed through the Mat. Shape => (Rows, Columns)
   --  has the same geometry as the Rows/Columns overload. No data is
   --  copied and the caller retains ownership. Callback lifetime and escape
   --  rules are identical to the Rows/Columns overload: shallow copies,
   --  Slice, and Reshape are rejected; Clone is the independent escape path.
   --  Gapped N-D storage uses With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View (Shape,
   --  Strides).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable Mat that aliases Data using
   --  Row_Stride_Elements complete Float32 elements between logical rows.
   --  Image (Row, Column) is Data (Data'First + Row *
   --  Row_Stride_Elements + Column). Row_Stride_Elements must be at least
   --  Columns, and Data'Length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride_Elements.
   --  Data must own a complete stride for every row, including padding after
   --  the final logical row. Padding and trailing storage are not part of
   --  Image. The lifetime,
   --  aliasing, and escape rules are the same as With_Writable_Mat_View.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride_Elements.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride_Elements Distance, in Float32 elements, between the
   --  starts of consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride_Elements is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride_Elements, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data                : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows                : Positive;
      Columns             : Positive;
      Row_Stride_Elements : Positive;
      Process             : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable strided N-dimensional
   --  CV_32FC1 Mat that aliases Data. Shape'Length must be in 2 .. 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) with
   --  positive extents, and Strides supplies exactly one stride per
   --  dimension in the same order; neither array's index bounds matter.
   --  Strides count complete Float32 elements, not bytes. The final stride
   --  must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner block:
   --  Strides (I) >= Strides (I + 1) * Shape (I + 1), so layouts never
   --  overlap or run backwards. Zero-based index (I1, .., In) is
   --  Data (Data'First + I1 * S1 + .. + In * Sn). Data'Length must be at
   --  least Shape (first) * Strides (first): the complete outer stride,
   --  including padding after the final logical outer block, is part of the
   --  native header and must exist. Extra trailing storage is allowed and is
   --  outside the header; padding is never a logical element and is not
   --  touched. Is_Continuous reports the actual layout, so packed-equivalent
   --  strides are continuous. No data is copied and the caller retains
   --  ownership. Callback lifetime and escape rules match the other
   --  overloads: shallow copies, Slice, Reshape, and output handles are
   --  rejected; Clone is the independent escape path and holds only the
   --  logical values.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Shape (first) * Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in Float32 elements (not
   --  bytes); the final stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its
   --  nested inner block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, the two arrays differ in length, or Data
   --  is too short.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only caller-owned zero-copy views; aliased constant Data is valid.
   --  Geometry/capacity match the corresponding writable overloads above.
   --  Mode-in Image forbids normal Ada mutation (not OS page protection).
   --  Shallow escape is rejected; Clone owns pixels; module input is allowed.
   --  This overload views a packed row-major buffer; Data'Length must equal
   --  Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed N-dimensional buffer, with the geometry
   --  rules of the writable N-dimensional overload: Shape has 2 to 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0)
   --  positive extents and Data'Length equals their product. The temporary
   --  Image is valid only during the callback.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases; it may
   --  be an aliased constant.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  is invalid, has more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, or
   --  Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a two-dimensional buffer with Row_Stride Float32
   --  elements between row starts, following the geometry and capacity rules
   --  of the writable strided overload. Padding between rows is not part of
   --  the logical Mat. The temporary Image is valid only during the callback.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in Float32 elements, between row starts; at
   --  least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is too short, or a dimension
   --  exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a strided N-dimensional buffer, following the
   --  geometry, stride and capacity rules of the writable strided
   --  N-dimensional overload. Strides count complete Float32 elements, not
   --  bytes. The temporary Image is valid only during the callback.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in Float32 elements; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, or Data is too short.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Matx3x3_Conversions.name: To_Mat
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Matx3x3_Conversions.signature:
--  Creates a new 3 x 3 single-channel Float32 Mat holding a copy of
   --  Value. Element (Row, Column) of Value becomes the Mat element at that
   --  zero-based row and column. The result owns independent storage.
   --  @param Value The matrix to copy.
   --  @return A new Float32 C1 Mat with 3 rows and 3 columns.
   function To_Mat (Value : OpenCV.Core.Float32_Matx3x3.Matrix) return Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Matx3x3_Conversions.name: To_Matx3x3
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Matx3x3_Conversions.signature:
--  Copies a 3 x 3 single-channel Float32 Mat into a fixed-size Matrix.
   --  The Mat is not modified and the result shares no storage with it.
   --  Non-contiguous Regions are accepted.
   --  @param Image The Mat to read; it must have exactly three rows, three
   --  columns, Float32 depth and one channel.
   --  @return A Matrix whose element (Row, Column) is the Mat element at that
   --  zero-based row and column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image does not have exactly three
   --  rows, three columns, Float32 depth and one channel.
   function To_Matx3x3 (Image : Mat) return OpenCV.Core.Float32_Matx3x3.Matrix;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.name: Column_Index
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based column position within a row.
   subtype Column_Index is Natural;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.name: Row_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.signature:
--  The values of one Mat row, one Float32_Value per column. Array bounds
   --  are the caller's choice: only the length matters, and the first array
   --  element always corresponds to column 0. The zero-copy callbacks pass
   --  arrays whose bounds are 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   type Row_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float32_Value;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.name: Read_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies one row of Image into Data. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) receives column 0 and the array's
   --  index bounds are otherwise irrelevant. Image is unchanged, Data owns
   --  its values, and non-contiguous Regions are supported.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data Receives one value per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  single-channel Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Read_Row (Image : Mat; Row : Natural; Data : out Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.name: Write_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies Data into one row of Image. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) is stored in column 0. The values are
   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them. Non-contiguous Regions are supported.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One value per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  single-channel Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of one Float32 C1 Mat row.
   --  Data directly aliases native OpenCV storage for that logical row;
   --  no pixel values are copied. The explicitly aliased callback
   --  formal guarantees that Data is passed by reference and directly
   --  denotes the borrowed Mat row for the duration of Process. The
   --  ordinary lifetime of the view is the callback. Data is indexed
   --  with zero-based Mat columns:
   --  Data'First = 0, Data'Last = Image.Columns - 1, and Data'Length =
   --  Image.Columns. Only the active row elements are exposed, never
   --  inter-row padding. Non-contiguous Regions are supported because
   --  each 2-D logical row remains a contiguous sequence even when the
   --  parent stride is larger. The implementation holds a shallow Mat
   --  lease for the callback so referenced storage cannot disappear
   --  merely because another header is rebound or finalized. That lease
   --  is deterministic memory management, not thread synchronization.
   --  Do not retain a reference or address of Data after Process
   --  returns. Read-only access performs no copy; if another alias
   --  mutates the shared storage during the callback, Data observes
   --  those changes according to ordinary aliasing rules.
   --  Image.Is_Continuous is not required.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row. Data is valid
   --  only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Float32 single-channel Mat or Row is outside
   --  the Mat.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Row
     (Image   : Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.name: With_Writable_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Row_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Row, except Process receives an in-out view.
   --  Writes through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  There is no write-back phase. A write through Data is visible
   --  through Image and any shallow alias before Process returns, and
   --  a write through another alias is immediately visible through
   --  Data. Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged; any
   --  writes completed before the exception remain visible.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Float32 single-channel Mat or Row is outside
   --  the Mat.
   procedure With_Writable_Row
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Reads the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The two channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32 two-channel
   --  Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get
     (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return Float32_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Writes the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat. Both channels are stored together, in the Mat's
   --  actual storage, and are visible through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @param Value The two channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32 two-channel
   --  Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Row, Column : Integer; Value : Float32_Vec2.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional access. Indices'Length must equal
   --  Image.Dimension_Count. Iteration order maps to OpenCV dimensions
   --  regardless of the array's index bounds. One vector is one complete
   --  two-channel element.
   --  @param Image A Float32 Mat with exactly two channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The two channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32 two-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   function Get
     (Image : Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return Float32_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write of one complete two-channel element;
   --  the indexing rules of the matching Get apply. Both channels are stored
   --  together, in the Mat's actual storage, and are visible through every
   --  header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A Float32 Mat with exactly two channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The two channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32 two-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Indices : Index_Array; Value : Float32_Vec2.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Buffer_Access.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  The flat pixel buffer of a Mat: one Float32_Vec2.Vector per Mat
   --  element, in OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying
   --  fastest. The callbacks pass arrays whose bounds are
   --  0 .. Natural (Image.Total) - 1.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float32_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  Callback-scoped zero-copy borrow of a continuous Float32 C2 Mat of
   --  any dimension count; genuine N-D Mats are supported. Data is one
   --  flat zero-based array, Data'Length = Natural (Image.Total), in
   --  OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying fastest; for
   --  a 2-D Mat, Data (Row * Image.Columns + Column) is (Row, Column).
   --  Each element is one complete C2 element; channels are never
   --  flattened. Non-continuous Mats (gapped Regions or Slices) raise
   --  OpenCV_Error before Process runs. A shallow Mat lease keeps the
   --  storage alive (memory lifetime, not synchronization); writes are
   --  immediately visible. References must not escape the callback.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float32 two-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except Process receives an in-out view;
   --  writes through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float32 two-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of Float32_Vec2.Vector pixels supplied by the caller. Its
   --  index bounds are the caller's choice: only Data'First (the first
   --  element) and Data'Length (the capacity) are used.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float32_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  One Data element is one complete C2 element. The temporary Mat must
   --  not escape Process; Clone is the supported independent escape path.
   --  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_32FC2 Mat that aliases
   --  Data; Image (Row, Column) is Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column)
   --  and Data'Length must equal Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image, within the native signed
   --  32-bit range.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image, within the native
   --  signed 32-bit range.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Packed N-D view: Shape'Length in 2 .. 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), positive extents in OpenCV
   --  dimension order, Data'Length = product (Shape) complete C2 elements,
   --  final dimension fastest. Neither Ada lower bound is visible. No copy;
   --  the caller keeps ownership; shallow escape (including Slice and
   --  Reshape) is rejected and Clone is the independent escape path.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length, in pixels, must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  2-D row-strided view. Row_Stride counts Vec2 elements; backing
   --  includes final-row padding. Image (Row, Column) maps to
   --  Data (Data'First + Row * Row_Stride + Column).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in pixels, between the starts of
   --  consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   :
        not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Strided N-D view: one stride per Shape dimension (bounds irrelevant),
   --  counted in complete Vec2 elements, not scalars or bytes. Final stride
   --  is 1 and Strides (I) >= Strides (I + 1) * Shape (I + 1). Index
   --  (I1, .., In) is Data (Data'First + I1 * S1 + .. + In * Sn).
   --  Data'Length >= Shape (first) * Strides (first), including final outer
   --  padding; extra trailing entries are allowed and padding is untouched.
   --  No copy; the caller keeps ownership; shallow escape is rejected and
   --  Clone is the independent escape path.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in pixels; the final stride
   --  must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, the two arrays differ in length, or Data
   --  is too short.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only zero-copy caller-owned views (one Data entry per vector).
   --  Aliased constant Data is accepted; geometry/capacity are exactly those
   --  of the corresponding writable overloads. Mode-in Image prevents normal
   --  Ada mutation, not OS/page writes. Shallow escape is rejected; Clone
   --  owns independent pixels and Module_Interop input is allowed.
   --  This overload views a packed row-major buffer; Data'Length must equal
   --  Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length, in pixels, must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed N-dimensional buffer, with the geometry
   --  rules of the writable N-dimensional overload: Shape has 2 to 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0)
   --  positive extents and Data'Length equals their product.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases; it may
   --  be an aliased constant.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  is invalid, has more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, or
   --  Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a two-dimensional buffer with Row_Stride pixels
   --  between row starts, following the geometry and capacity rules of the
   --  writable strided overload. Padding between rows is not part of the
   --  logical Mat.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in pixels, between row starts; at least
   --  Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is too short, or a dimension
   --  exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a strided N-dimensional buffer, following the
   --  geometry, stride and capacity rules of the writable strided
   --  N-dimensional overload. Strides count complete pixels, not scalar
   --  channels and not bytes.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in pixels; the final stride
   --  must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, or Data is too short.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.name: Column_Index
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based column position within a row.
   subtype Column_Index is Natural;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.name: Row_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  The pixels of one Mat row, one Float32_Vec2.Vector per column. Array
   --  bounds are the caller's choice: only the length matters, and the first
   --  array element always corresponds to column 0.
   type Row_Array is array (Natural range <>) of Float32_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.name: Read_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies one row of Image into Data. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) receives column 0. Image is
   --  unchanged and Data owns its values.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data Receives one two-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32 two-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Read_Row (Image : Mat; Row : Natural; Data : out Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.name: Write_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies Data into one row of Image. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) is stored in column 0. The values are
   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One two-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32 two-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  Borrowed storage is valid only during Process; no references may escape.
   --  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of one Float32 C2 Mat row. Data
   --  aliases native storage for that row, one complete pixel per element, and
   --  is indexed with zero-based columns (Data'Length = Image.Columns).
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row. Data is valid
   --  only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Float32 two-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Row
     (Image   : Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.name: With_Writable_Row
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Row, except Process receives an in-out view; writes
   --  through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Float32 two-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Writable_Row
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Reads the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The three channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  three-channel Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get
     (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer)
      return OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Writes the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat. All three channels are stored together, in the
   --  Mat's actual storage, and are visible through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Float32 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @param Value The three channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  three-channel Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   procedure Set
     (Image  : in out Mat;
      Row    : Integer;
      Column : Integer;
      Value  : OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional access. Indices'Length must equal
   --  Image.Dimension_Count. Iteration order maps to OpenCV dimensions
   --  regardless of the array's index bounds. One vector is one complete
   --  three-channel element.
   --  @param Image A Float32 Mat with exactly three channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The three channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  three-channel Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per
   --  dimension, or an index is out of range.
   function Get
     (Image : Mat; Indices : Index_Array)
      return OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write of one complete three-channel element;
   --  the indexing rules of the matching Get apply. All three channels are
   --  stored together, in the Mat's actual storage, and are visible through
   --  every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A Float32 Mat with exactly three channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The three channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a Float32
   --  three-channel Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per
   --  dimension, or an index is out of range.
   procedure Set
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Indices : Index_Array;
      Value   : OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Buffer_Access.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  The flat pixel buffer of a Mat: one Float32_Vec3.Vector per Mat
   --  element, in OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying
   --  fastest. The callbacks pass arrays whose bounds are
   --  0 .. Natural (Image.Total) - 1.
   type Buffer_Array is
     array (Natural range <>) of OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of a continuous Float32 C3
   --  Mat of any dimension count; genuine N-D Mats are supported.
   --  Data directly aliases native OpenCV storage for the entire
   --  logical buffer; no pixel values are copied. Each Data element is
   --  one complete interleaved C3 pixel: Data (Index) (0 .. 2) are the
   --  three native Float32 channels; channels are never flattened into
   --  Data indexing. The explicitly aliased callback
   --  formal guarantees that Data is passed by reference and directly
   --  denotes the borrowed Mat for the duration of Process. The
   --  ordinary lifetime of the view is the callback. Data is one flat
   --  zero-based array of Mat pixels in OpenCV element order, final
   --  dimension varying fastest:
   --  Data'First = 0, Data'Last = Natural (Image.Total) - 1, and
   --  Data'Length = Natural (Image.Total). For Shape (D1, ..., Dn),
   --  zero-based index (I1, ..., In) is Data offset
   --  ((I1 * D2 + I2) * D3 + ...) * Dn + In. For a 2-D Mat, element
   --  Data (Row * Image.Columns + Column) denotes Image (Row, Column).
   --  There are no row separators, padding, or gaps. Image must be
   --  continuous (Is_Continuous); a nonempty non-continuous Mat, such
   --  as a gapped Region or Slice, raises OpenCV_Error before Process
   --  is invoked. A continuous Region or N-D Slice is accepted even
   --  when it is a submatrix. The implementation holds one shallow Mat
   --  lease for the callback so referenced storage cannot disappear
   --  merely because another header is rebound or finalized. That lease
   --  is deterministic memory management, not thread synchronization.
   --  Do not retain a reference or address of Data after Process
   --  returns. Read-only access performs no copy; if another alias
   --  mutates the shared storage during the callback, Data observes
   --  those changes according to ordinary aliasing rules.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float32 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float32 three-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except Process receives an in-out view.
   --  Writes through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  There is no write-back phase. A write through Data is visible
   --  through Image and any shallow alias before Process returns, and
   --  a write through another alias is immediately visible through
   --  Data. Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged; any
   --  writes completed before the exception remain visible.
   --  @param Image A continuous Float32 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a Float32 three-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of Float32_Vec3.Vector pixels supplied by the caller. Its
   --  index bounds are the caller's choice: only Data'First (the first
   --  pixel) and Data'Length (the capacity, counted in pixels) are used, and
   --  the lower bound is not exposed through the Mat.
   type Buffer_Array is
     array (Natural range <>) of OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_32FC3 Mat that aliases
   --  Data.  Each Data component is one complete pixel.  Image (Row, Column)
   --  is Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column).  Data'Length must equal
   --  Rows * Columns; it counts pixels, not scalar channels.  Image is valid
   --  only during Process and must not be retained.  Clone is the supported
   --  way to keep an independent Mat.  The aliased formal passes Data by
   --  reference, so Image denotes caller-owned storage without copying it.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image, within the native signed
   --  32-bit range.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image, within the native
   --  signed 32-bit range.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows    : Positive;
      Columns : Positive;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed N-dimensional
   --  CV_32FC3 Mat that aliases Data. One Data component is one complete C3
   --  element. Shape'Length must be in 2 .. 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) and every extent must be
   --  positive; Shape iteration order maps directly to OpenCV dimension
   --  order regardless of Shape'First. Data'Length must equal product
   --  (Shape) exactly; it counts pixels, not scalar channels. Storage is
   --  packed and continuous with the final dimension varying fastest:
   --  zero-based index (I1, .., In) is Data (Data'First + ((I1 * D2 + I2) *
   --  D3 + ..) * Dn + In). Neither Ada lower bound is exposed through the
   --  Mat. Shape => (Rows, Columns) has the same geometry as the
   --  Rows/Columns overload. No data is copied and the caller retains
   --  ownership. Callback lifetime and escape rules are identical to the
   --  Rows/Columns overload: shallow copies, Slice, and Reshape are
   --  rejected; Clone is the independent escape path. Gapped N-D storage
   --  uses With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View (Shape, Strides).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length, in pixels, must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_32FC3 Mat that aliases
   --  Data with Row_Stride complete Float32_Vec3 pixels between logical row
   --  starts. Row_Stride counts pixels, not scalar channels and not bytes.
   --  Row_Stride must be at least Columns. Image (Row, Column) maps to
   --  Data (Data'First + Row * Row_Stride + Column). Data'Length must be at
   --  least Rows * Row_Stride, including padding pixels after the final
   --  logical row. Padding and extra trailing pixels are outside the logical
   --  Mat. No data is copied. Ownership, callback lifetime, and escape rules
   --  are identical to With_Writable_Mat_View; Clone is the safe escape path.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in pixels, between the starts of
   --  consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data       : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows       : Positive;
      Columns    : Positive;
      Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process    : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.Float32_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable strided N-dimensional
   --  CV_32FC3 Mat that aliases Data. Shape'Length must be in 2 .. 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) with
   --  positive extents, and Strides supplies exactly one stride per
   --  dimension in the same order; neither array's index bounds matter.
   --  Strides count complete Float32_Vec3 pixels, not scalar channels and
   --  not bytes. The final stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover
   --  its nested inner block: Strides (I) >= Strides (I + 1) * Shape (I + 1).
   --  Zero-based index (I1, .., In) is Data (Data'First + I1 * S1 + .. +
   --  In * Sn). Data'Length must be at least Shape (first) * Strides
   --  (first) pixels, including padding after the final logical outer
   --  block, which the native header covers. Extra trailing pixels are
   --  allowed and are outside the header; padding is never touched.
   --  Is_Continuous reports the actual layout. No data is copied and the
   --  caller retains ownership. Shallow copies, Slice, Reshape, and output
   --  handles are rejected; Clone is the independent escape path.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length, in pixels, must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in pixels; the final stride
   --  must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
