   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Int8 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Reads the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat.

   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The four channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not an Int8 four-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return Int8_Vec4.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Writes the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat. All four channels are stored together, in the
   --  Mat's actual storage, and are visible through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Int8 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.

   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not an Int8 four-channel

     (Image : in out Mat; Row, Column : Integer; Value : Int8_Vec4.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Reads the complete element at a zero-based N-dimensional index.
   --  Indices'Length must equal Image.Dimension_Count. One vector is one
   --  complete four-channel element.
   --  @param Image An Int8 Mat with exactly four channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The four channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not an Int8 four-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write of one complete four-channel element;
   --  the indexing rules of the matching Get apply. All four channels are
   --  stored together, in the Mat's actual storage, and are visible through
   --  every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image An Int8 Mat with exactly four channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.

   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not an Int8 four-channel

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of a continuous Int8 C4 Mat of
   --  any dimension count; genuine N-D Mats are supported. Data directly
   --  aliases native CV_8SC4 storage. Each Data element is one complete
   --  4-byte C4 element: Data (Index) (0 .. 3) are channels 0 .. 3 holding
   --  signed -128 .. 127 values; channels are never flattened into Data
   --  indexing. Data'First = 0 and Data'Length = Natural (Image.Total), in
   --  OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying fastest. Image
   --  must be continuous; a nonempty non-continuous Mat (gapped Region or
   --  Slice) raises OpenCV_Error before Process is invoked. A shallow Mat
   --  lease keeps storage alive for the callback (memory management, not
   --  thread synchronization). Do not retain a reference or address of Data
   --  after Process returns.
   --  @param Image A continuous Int8 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not an Int8 four-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except writes through Data mutate the Mat
   --  storage immediately. Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged;
   --  completed writes remain visible.
   --  @param Image A continuous Int8 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not an Int8 four-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Int8 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One four-channel vector per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not an Int8 four-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of one row. Data aliases the
   --  native row and is zero-based with Data'Length = Image.Columns.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Int8 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row. Data is valid
   --  only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Int8 four-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Row
     (Image   : Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Row_Access.name: With_Writable_Row
OpenCV.Core.Int8_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Row, except Process receives an in-out view whose
   --  writes mutate the Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional Int8 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional Int8 four-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Writable_Row
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: Input_Mat_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Read-only native Mat handle for cooperating module crates. It is
   --  valid only during the callback that receives it and is neither owned
   --  nor retained by the receiver.
   type Input_Mat_Handle is private;

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: Output_Mat_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Writable native Mat handle for cooperating module crates. It exposes
   --  the actual Core header, which an output operation may rebind, and is
   --  valid only during the callback that receives it.
   type Output_Mat_Handle is private;

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: With_Input_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Invokes Process with an input handle for Image's native header. The
   --  handle is valid only during Process; it must not be stored or used
   --  afterwards. No elements are copied. Exceptions raised by Process
   --  propagate unchanged.
   --  @param Image The Mat whose native header is borrowed.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed handle.
   procedure With_Input_Handle
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Handle : Input_Mat_Handle));

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: With_Output_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Invokes Process with an output handle for Image's actual Core header,
   --  so a native operation may recreate or rebind it in place. The header
   --  is resolved before Process runs; in particular a temporary
   --  external-buffer view is rejected, because its header cannot safely be
   --  rebound by an OutputArray operation. The handle is valid only during
   --  Process and must not be stored or used afterwards. Exceptions raised
   --  by Process propagate unchanged.
   --  @param Image The Mat whose native header is borrowed for writing.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed handle.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when the
   --  header cannot be used as an output, such as a temporary view.
   procedure With_Output_Handle
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Handle : Output_Mat_Handle));

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: Input_UMat_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Read-only native UMat handle. UMat handles have the same callback-only
   --  lifetime as the Mat handles. A cooperating module may pass them only to
   --  its private native interop layer. Core owns both the opaque wrapper and
   --  original cv::UMat header: do not delete the header or retain its
   --  pointer after the callback/call scope. No public native pointer
   --  escapes and no ownership transfer, Mat conversion, or mapping occurs.
   --  All module shims must use a compatible OpenCV ABI/installation with
   --  Core.
   type Input_UMat_Handle is private;

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: Output_UMat_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Writable native UMat handle with the same callback-only lifetime and
   --  ownership rules as Input_UMat_Handle. It exposes the actual Core-owned
   --  header, which an output operation may rebind.
   type Output_UMat_Handle is private;

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: With_Input_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Invokes Process with an input handle for Image's native cv::UMat
   --  header. The handle is valid only during Process; it must not be stored,
   --  deleted or used afterwards. No Mat conversion or host mapping occurs.
   --  Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged.
   --  @param Image The UMat whose native header is borrowed.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed handle.
   procedure With_Input_Handle
     (Image   : UMat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Handle : Input_UMat_Handle));

OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.name: With_Output_Handle
OpenCV.Core.Module_Interop.signature:
--  Invokes Process with an output handle for Image's actual Core-owned
   --  cv::UMat header, which an output operation may rebind. The handle is
   --  valid only during Process; it must not be stored, deleted or used
   --  afterwards. No Mat conversion or host mapping occurs. Exceptions
   --  raised by Process propagate unchanged.
   --  @param Image The UMat whose native header is borrowed for writing.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed handle.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when the
   --  native header cannot be resolved.
   procedure With_Output_Handle
     (Image   : in out UMat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Handle : Output_UMat_Handle));

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Node_Kind
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Structural OpenCV FileNode category, not a high-level object type.
   --  A persisted Mat is a mapping (Mapping_Node); Read_Mat performs the
   --  explicit Mat conversion. No FileNode object or iterator is exposed.
   --  @enum Integer_Node A signed 32-bit integer node, read by Read_Integer.
   --  @enum Real_Node A floating-point node, read by Read_Real.
   --  @enum String_Node A string node, read by Read_String.
   --  @enum Sequence_Node An ordered sequence, entered by Enter_Sequence.
   --  @enum Mapping_Node A mapping of names to nodes, entered by Enter_Map.
   --  A serialized Mat is also reported as Mapping_Node.
   type Node_Kind is
     (Integer_Node, Real_Node, String_Node, Sequence_Node, Mapping_Node);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Storage_Mode
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Direction in which a File_Storage was opened. It is fixed for the
   --  life of the storage.
   --  @enum Read_Only The storage is parsed from a file or text and supports
   --  the Read, Enter, Kind and length operations.
   --  @enum Write_Only The storage is written and supports the Write,
   --  Begin, Append and End operations.
   type Storage_Mode is (Read_Only, Write_Only);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Storage_Format
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Serialization format of a memory-backed writer created by
   --  Create_Memory.
   --  @enum XML The document is serialized as XML.
   --  @enum YAML The document is serialized as YAML.
   --  @enum JSON The document is serialized as JSON.
   type Storage_Format is (XML, YAML, JSON);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: File_Storage
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Handle to an OpenCV FileStorage opened for reading or writing, from a
   --  disk file or an in-memory buffer. File_Storage is limited, so it cannot
   --  be copied or assigned: exactly one Ada object owns the native storage,
   --  and finalization of that object closes it. The object keeps a current
   --  read or write context (the implicit root, a mapping, or a sequence)
   --  that the Enter, Begin, Leave and End operations move. Operations
   --  that do not suit the opened Storage_Mode or the current context raise
   --  OpenCV_Error.
   type File_Storage is new Ada.Finalization.Limited_Controlled with private;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Open
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Opens Filename for reading or writing. Format is selected from
   --  the filename extension. Raises OpenCV_Error if Filename is empty,
   --  contains an embedded NUL, or cannot be opened. Write_Only follows
   --  cv::FileStorage WRITE mode, which creates the file or replaces an
   --  existing one; the document is completed when the storage is finalized.
   --  @param Filename Path whose extension (.xml, .yml, .yaml or .json)
   --  selects the format.
   --  @param Mode Whether the file is read or written.
   --  @return An open File_Storage positioned at the implicit root.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Filename is empty, contains an
   --  embedded NUL, or cannot be opened.
   function Open (Filename : String; Mode : Storage_Mode) return File_Storage;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Create_Memory
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Creates an open Write_Only memory-backed File_Storage that
   --  serializes to Format. No file is created. Existing Write
   --  operations work unchanged. Close_And_Get_Text returns the
   --  serialized document and closes the storage.
   --  @param Format Serialization format of the document.
   --  @return An open, Write_Only File_Storage positioned at the implicit
   --  root.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when OpenCV cannot open the storage.
   function Create_Memory (Format : Storage_Format) return File_Storage;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Open_Memory
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Opens Text as a Read_Only memory-backed File_Storage. OpenCV
   --  4.10 auto-detects XML, YAML, or JSON from the contents. Raises
   --  OpenCV_Error if Text is empty, contains an embedded NUL, or
   --  cannot be parsed.
   --  @param Text A previously serialized document.
   --  @return An open, Read_Only File_Storage positioned at the implicit
   --  root.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Text is empty, contains an
   --  embedded NUL, or cannot be parsed.
   function Open_Memory (Text : String) return File_Storage;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Close_And_Get_Text
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Finalizes an open memory Write_Only File_Storage, releases the
   --  OpenCV writer, and returns the complete serialized document.
   --  Self becomes closed on a successful first finish even if a later
   --  Ada conversion fails. Subsequent Write, Read, and
   --  Close_And_Get_Text calls raise OpenCV_Error. Disk storage,
   --  memory readers, and writers with unclosed structures raise
   --  OpenCV_Error. An unbalanced Close_And_Get_Text does not close
   --  the writer. The returned String does not
   --  depend on Self.
   --  @param Self The memory-backed Write_Only storage to finish.
   --  @return The complete serialized document.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised for disk storage, a reader, a closed
   --  storage, or a writer with unclosed structures.
   function Close_And_Get_Text (Self : in out File_Storage) return String;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Write
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Writes Value under Name. Self must be an open Write_Only storage.
   --  Value is borrowed and is not modified. Empty and non-contiguous
   --  Mats are accepted. Raises OpenCV_Error if Self is not open for
   --  writing or if Name is empty or contains an embedded NUL.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node, in the current root
   --  or mapping.
   --  @param Value The Mat to persist.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing, the
   --  current context is a sequence, or Name is empty or contains an
   --  embedded NUL.
   procedure Write (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String; Value : Mat);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Write
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Writes Value as an OpenCV signed 32-bit integer node. With
   --  OpenCV 4.10, Value must be in -2_147_483_647 .. 2_147_483_647
   --  because OpenCV formats integers with abs(int). Raises
   --  OpenCV_Error if Value is outside that write domain, if Self is
   --  not open for writing, or if Name is empty or contains an
   --  embedded NUL.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node, in the current root
   --  or mapping.
   --  @param Value The integer to persist, in -2_147_483_647 ..
   --  2_147_483_647.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Value is outside the write domain,
   --  Self is not open for writing, the current context is a sequence, or
   --  Name is empty or contains an embedded NUL.
   procedure Write
     (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String; Value : Integer);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Write
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Writes Value as an OpenCV double node. Raises OpenCV_Error if
   --  Self is not open for writing or if Name is empty or contains an
   --  embedded NUL.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node, in the current root
   --  or mapping.
   --  @param Value The real number to persist.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing, the
   --  current context is a sequence, or Name is empty or contains an
   --  embedded NUL.
   procedure Write
     (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String; Value : Long_Float);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Write
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Writes Value as an OpenCV string node. Raises OpenCV_Error if
   --  Value contains an embedded NUL, if Self is not open for writing,
   --  or if Name is empty or contains an embedded NUL.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node, in the current root
   --  or mapping.
   --  @param Value The NUL-free string to persist; it may be empty.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Value or Name contains an embedded
   --  NUL, Self is not open for writing, the current context is a sequence,
   --  or Name is empty.
   procedure Write (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String; Value : String);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Begin_Map
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Starts a named mapping child of the current root or mapping.
   --  Raises OpenCV_Error if Self is not open for writing, if Name is
   --  empty or contains an embedded NUL, or if the current write
   --  context is a sequence. Close it with End_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the new mapping.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing,
   --  Name is empty or contains an embedded NUL, or the current context is a
   --  sequence.
   procedure Begin_Map (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Begin_Map
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Starts an unnamed mapping element of the current sequence.
   --  Raises OpenCV_Error if Self is not open for writing or if the
   --  current write context is not a sequence. Close it with End_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing or
   --  the current context is not a sequence.
   procedure Begin_Map (Self : in out File_Storage);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Begin_Sequence
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Starts a named sequence child of the current root or mapping.
   --  Raises OpenCV_Error if Self is not open for writing, if Name is
   --  empty or contains an embedded NUL, or if the current write
   --  context is a sequence. Close it with End_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the new sequence.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing,
   --  Name is empty or contains an embedded NUL, or the current context is a
   --  sequence.
   procedure Begin_Sequence (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Begin_Sequence
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Starts an unnamed sequence element of the current sequence.
   --  Raises OpenCV_Error if Self is not open for writing or if the
   --  current write context is not a sequence. Close it with End_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing or
   --  the current context is not a sequence.
   procedure Begin_Sequence (Self : in out File_Storage);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: End_Structure
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Ends the current mapping or sequence opened by Begin_Map or
   --  Begin_Sequence. The implicit root cannot be closed.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing or
   --  no structure is open.
   procedure End_Structure (Self : in out File_Storage);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Append
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Appends Value as the next element of the current sequence.
   --  Valid only while the current write context is a sequence. Empty and
   --  non-contiguous Mats are accepted.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Value The Mat to append.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing or
   --  the current context is not a sequence.
   procedure Append (Self : in out File_Storage; Value : Mat);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Append
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Appends Value as the next element of the current sequence, as an
   --  OpenCV signed 32-bit integer node. Valid only while the current write
   --  context is a sequence. The write domain of the named Write for Integer
   --  applies.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Value The integer to append, in -2_147_483_647 ..
   --  2_147_483_647.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Value is outside the write domain,
   --  Self is not open for writing, or the current context is not a
   --  sequence.
   procedure Append (Self : in out File_Storage; Value : Integer);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Append
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Appends Value as the next element of the current sequence, as an
   --  OpenCV double node. Valid only while the current write context is a
   --  sequence.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Value The real number to append.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for writing or
   --  the current context is not a sequence.
   procedure Append (Self : in out File_Storage; Value : Long_Float);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Append
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Appends Value as a string sequence element. Raises OpenCV_Error
   --  if Value contains an embedded NUL.
   --  @param Self The open Write_Only storage.
   --  @param Value The NUL-free string to append; it may be empty.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Value contains an embedded NUL,
   --  Self is not open for writing, or the current context is not a
   --  sequence.
   procedure Append (Self : in out File_Storage; Value : String);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Enter_Map
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Enters the named mapping child of the current root or mapping.
   --  A missing name or a non-mapping node raises OpenCV_Error. Leave it
   --  with Leave_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the mapping.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the name is missing, the node is
   --  not a mapping, or the current context is a sequence.
   procedure Enter_Map (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Enter_Map
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Enters the indexed mapping child of the current sequence.
   --  Index is zero-based. Valid only inside a sequence. Leave it with
   --  Leave_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in the current sequence.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the current context is not a
   --  sequence, Index is out of range, or the node is not a mapping.
   procedure Enter_Map (Self : in out File_Storage; Index : Natural);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Enter_Sequence
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Enters the named sequence child of the current root or mapping.
   --  A missing name or a non-sequence node raises OpenCV_Error. Leave it
   --  with Leave_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the sequence.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the name is missing, the node is
   --  not a sequence, or the current context is a sequence.
   procedure Enter_Sequence (Self : in out File_Storage; Name : String);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Enter_Sequence
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Enters the indexed sequence child of the current sequence.
   --  Index is zero-based. Valid only inside a sequence. Leave it with
   --  Leave_Structure.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in the current sequence.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the current context is not a
   --  sequence, Index is out of range, or the node is not a sequence.
   procedure Enter_Sequence (Self : in out File_Storage; Index : Natural);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Leave_Structure
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Returns to the parent read context. The implicit root cannot be
   --  left.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the current context is the
   --  implicit root.
   procedure Leave_Structure (Self : in out File_Storage);

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Sequence_Length
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Returns FileNode::size of the current sequence. Valid only
   --  while the current read context is a sequence.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @return The number of elements of the current sequence.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the current context is not a
   --  sequence.
   function Sequence_Length (Self : File_Storage) return Natural;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Map_Length
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Counts entries at the implicit root (stream 0) or in the entered
   --  mapping. A current mapping with no entries has length zero. Self
   --  must be open Read_Only; a sequence context raises OpenCV_Error.
   --  Navigation is unchanged.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @return The number of entries of the current root or mapping.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for reading or
   --  the current context is a sequence.
   function Map_Length (Self : File_Storage) return Natural;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Map_Key
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Returns the zero-based Index key in OpenCV's FileNode mapping
   --  iteration order (not sorted). The String is independently owned.
   --  Requires open Read_Only storage and Index < Map_Length (Self);
   --  a sequence context or out-of-range index raises OpenCV_Error.
   --  Navigation is unchanged.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in iteration order.
   --  @return The name of that entry.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for reading, the
   --  context is a sequence, or Index is out of range.
   function Map_Key (Self : File_Storage; Index : Natural) return String;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Kind
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Observe an existing named child at the root or in an entered mapping.
   --  Requires open Read_Only storage and a nonempty, NUL-free name.
   --  Missing names and sequence contexts raise OpenCV_Error. Navigation
   --  is unchanged; serialized Mats report Mapping_Node.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the child.
   --  @return The structural category of the child.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for reading, the
   --  name is missing or invalid, or the context is a sequence.
   function Kind (Self : File_Storage; Name : String) return Node_Kind;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Kind
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Observe a zero-based child of the entered sequence. Requires open
   --  Read_Only storage; root/map contexts and out-of-range indices raise
   --  OpenCV_Error. Navigation is unchanged.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in the current sequence.
   --  @return The structural category of the child.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is not open for reading, the
   --  context is not a sequence, or Index is out of range.
   function Kind (Self : File_Storage; Index : Natural) return Node_Kind;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_Mat
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the named Mat. Self must be an open Read_Only storage. The
   --  result owns independent storage and does not depend on Self.
   --  A missing name raises OpenCV_Error. A present empty Mat returns
   --  an empty Mat. A node that cannot be converted to Mat raises
   --  OpenCV_Error.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node.
   --  @return A new Mat with independent storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the name is missing, the node
   --  cannot be converted to a Mat, or Self is not open for reading.
   function Read_Mat (Self : File_Storage; Name : String) return Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_Integer
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the named signed 32-bit integer node. A real, string, Mat,
   --  or missing node raises OpenCV_Error. The exact stored integer is
   --  returned.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node.
   --  @return The stored integer.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the node is missing or is not an
   --  integer node.
   function Read_Integer (Self : File_Storage; Name : String) return Integer;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_Real
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the named real node, or widens a named integer node to
   --  Long_Float. A string, Mat, or missing node raises OpenCV_Error.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node.
   --  @return The stored real number, or the widened integer.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the node is missing or is neither
   --  a real nor an integer node.
   function Read_Real (Self : File_Storage; Name : String) return Long_Float;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_String
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the named string node. Numeric, Mat, and missing nodes
   --  raise OpenCV_Error. An actually stored empty string is returned
   --  as "".
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Name Nonempty, NUL-free name of the node.
   --  @return The stored string, as an independently owned String.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the node is missing or is not a
   --  string node.
   function Read_String (Self : File_Storage; Name : String) return String;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_Mat
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the indexed current-sequence Mat. Index is zero-based.
   --  Valid only while the current read context is a sequence.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in the current sequence.
   --  @return A new Mat with independent storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the context is not a sequence,
   --  Index is out of range, or the node cannot be converted to a Mat.
   function Read_Mat (Self : File_Storage; Index : Natural) return Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_Integer
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the indexed current-sequence integer node. Index is
   --  zero-based. A real, string, Mat, or missing node raises
   --  OpenCV_Error.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in the current sequence.
   --  @return The stored integer.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the context is not a sequence,
   --  Index is out of range, or the node is not an integer node.
   function Read_Integer (Self : File_Storage; Index : Natural) return Integer;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_Real
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the indexed current-sequence real node, or widens an
   --  indexed integer node to Long_Float.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in the current sequence.
   --  @return The stored real number, or the widened integer.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the context is not a sequence,
   --  Index is out of range, or the node is neither a real nor an integer
   --  node.
   function Read_Real (Self : File_Storage; Index : Natural) return Long_Float;

OpenCV.Core.Persistence.name: Read_String
OpenCV.Core.Persistence.signature:
--  Reads the indexed current-sequence string node. Numeric, Mat,
   --  and missing nodes raise OpenCV_Error.
   --  @param Self The open Read_Only storage.
   --  @param Index Zero-based position in the current sequence.
   --  @return The stored string, as an independently owned String.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when the context is not a sequence,
   --  Index is out of range, or the node is not a string node.
   function Read_String (Self : File_Storage; Index : Natural) return String;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Sparse_Mat
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Runtime-typed sparse N-dimensional matrix backed by a native OpenCV
   --  cv::SparseMat. Unlike a dense Mat, only explicitly stored elements (the
   --  nodes) occupy memory and are visited by the reductions here; a missing
   --  coordinate is not the same as a stored zero, although both read as
   --  zero through the typed Get operations. Each Sparse_Mat object is a
   --  controlled header that owns its native resource. Ada assignment is
   --  shallow: the target receives its own header while the nodes stay shared
   --  and reference counted, so a write through one header is visible
   --  through the other. Clone makes an explicit deep copy. A default
   --  Sparse_Mat is unallocated: it reports zero dimensions and most
   --  operations reject it with OpenCV_Error. Sparse_Mat has no Region or
   --  view operations and is not interchangeable with Mat or UMat.
   type Sparse_Mat is tagged private;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Create
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Creates an allocated sparse matrix with no stored nodes. Shape is read
   --  in iteration order, independent of its index bounds: the first element
   --  is the extent of native dimension 0. Between 2 and 32 dimensions are
   --  required, and every extent must be positive. Element_Type fixes the
   --  depth and channel count of every stored element. Every coordinate is
   --  initially missing, and the matrix owns its storage independently.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, in native dimension order.
   --  @param Element_Type Depth and channel count of each stored element.
   --  @return A new, empty, allocated Sparse_Mat.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Shape has fewer than 2 or more
   --  than 32 dimensions, an extent is zero, or OpenCV rejects the shape.
   function Create
     (Shape : Dimension_Array; Element_Type : Mat_Type) return Sparse_Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: From_Dense
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Converts a dense Mat into an independent Sparse_Mat of the same shape,
   --  depth and channel count. Only elements that are not entirely zero are
   --  stored; an element is omitted when all of its stored bytes are zero,
   --  so a Float16 negative zero (16#8000#) and a NaN are stored. A
   --  multi-channel element is stored as a whole when any channel is
   --  nonzero. The result does not share storage with Source, and later
   --  changes to either do not affect the other. Non-contiguous Regions are
   --  accepted.
   --  @param Source The nonempty dense Mat to convert.
   --  @return A new Sparse_Mat holding the nonzero elements of Source.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Source is empty or OpenCV reports
   --  a failure.
   function From_Dense (Source : Mat) return Sparse_Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: To_Dense
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Converts Self into an independent dense Mat of the same shape, depth
   --  and channel count. Stored nodes are copied and every missing
   --  coordinate is zero. Self is unchanged and the result owns independent
   --  storage. The conversion is rejected when the dimension count exceeds
   --  the native dense Mat capacity (10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to expand.
   --  @return A new dense Mat with independent storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated, has too many
   --  dimensions for a dense Mat, or OpenCV reports a failure.
   function To_Dense (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Convert_To
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Native SparseMat::convertTo into an independent Sparse_Mat. Shape and
   --  channel count are preserved. Only stored nodes are converted, including
   --  an explicitly stored zero; missing coordinates stay missing. Each stored
   --  component becomes saturate_cast (source * Scale) at Depth. There is no
   --  offset. Scale 1.0 uses OpenCV's unscaled conversion. Float16 is not a
   --  supported source or destination: OpenCV 4.1 through 5.0 leave both
   --  directions null in the sparse conversion tables, and this binding does
   --  not substitute a Float32 fallback. Float16 Get/Set bit preservation is
   --  unchanged.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to convert.
   --  @param Depth Depth of the stored components of the result.
   --  @param Scale Factor applied to each stored component before
   --  saturation.
   --  @return A new Sparse_Mat with independent storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated, either depth
   --  is Float16, or OpenCV reports a failure.
   function Convert_To
     (Self : Sparse_Mat; Depth : Depth_Type; Scale : Long_Float := 1.0)
      return Sparse_Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: To_Dense
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Native SparseMat::convertTo into an independent dense Mat. Shape and
   --  channel count are preserved. A stored component becomes
   --  saturate_cast (source * Scale + Offset). A missing element is
   --  initialized with OpenCV Scalar (Offset): channel 0 receives Offset and
   --  every later channel receives 0, because Scalar supplies one value and
   --  three zeros. Float16 source and destination depths are rejected for the
   --  same OpenCV 4.1-5.0 table gap as Convert_To. On OpenCV 5, dimension
   --  counts above the native dense Mat capacity are rejected before
   --  conversion.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to expand.
   --  @param Depth Depth of the dense result.
   --  @param Scale Factor applied to each stored component.
   --  @param Offset Value added to each stored component, and used to
   --  initialize channel 0 of every missing element.
   --  @return A new dense Mat with independent storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated, either depth
   --  is Float16, the dimension count exceeds the dense Mat capacity, or
   --  OpenCV reports a failure.
   function To_Dense
     (Self   : Sparse_Mat;
      Depth  : Depth_Type;
      Scale  : Long_Float := 1.0;
      Offset : Long_Float := 0.0) return Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Norm
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Native sparse cv::norm over stored nodes only. Missing coordinates
   --  contribute zero and are not created. An explicitly stored zero
   --  contributes zero and remains a node. The matrix is not modified.
   --  Requires an allocated Float32 or Float64 matrix with exactly one
   --  channel. An allocated matrix with no stored nodes returns 0.0.
   --  L1 is the sum of absolute stored values, L2 is the square root of the
   --  sum of their squares, and Infinity is the maximum absolute stored
   --  value. Multi-channel, integer, and Float16 layouts are rejected
   --  before the ABI call. Min_Max is not a sparse norm.
   --  @param Self The allocated single-channel Float32 or Float64 matrix.
   --  @param Kind L1, L2 or infinity norm.
   --  @return The norm of the stored nodes.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised for an unallocated, multi-channel,
   --  integer or Float16 layout, or an OpenCV failure.
   function Norm (Self : Sparse_Mat; Kind : Norm_Kind := L2) return Long_Float;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Normalize
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Native sparse cv::normalize into an independent Sparse_Mat. Shape,
   --  depth, channel count, and stored-node coordinates are preserved,
   --  including explicitly stored zeros. Values are scaled by
   --  Target_Norm / Norm when that norm exceeds OpenCV's DBL_EPSILON;
   --  otherwise the scale is 0.0 and every stored value becomes zero while
   --  its node remains stored. An allocated matrix with no nodes stays
   --  empty. A negative Target_Norm is native and deterministic: it reverses
   --  the sign of every stored value. The source is unchanged. The same
   --  Float32/Float64 single-channel restriction as Norm applies. Min_Max
   --  normalization is unavailable because shifting implicit zeros would
   --  change sparse semantics.
   --  @param Self The allocated single-channel Float32 or Float64 matrix.
   --  @param Target_Norm Norm the stored values are scaled to.
   --  @param Kind L1, L2 or infinity norm.
   --  @return A new Sparse_Mat with independent storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised for an unallocated, multi-channel,
   --  integer or Float16 layout, or an OpenCV failure.
   function Normalize
     (Self        : Sparse_Mat;
      Target_Norm : Long_Float := 1.0;
      Kind        : Norm_Kind := L2) return Sparse_Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Sparse_Extrema
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Native sparse cv::minMaxLoc over stored nodes only. Requires an
   --  allocated Float32 or Float64 matrix with exactly one channel. Missing
   --  coordinates do not participate and are not created. An explicitly
   --  stored zero is a candidate. Comparisons use strict < and >, so the
   --  earliest node in OpenCV's hash traversal that holds an equal extremum
   --  is reported. That order is unspecified and is not insertion order.
   --  Negative zero compares equal to positive zero. NaN never replaces a
   --  finite extremum. Has_Minimum and Has_Maximum are independent: each is
   --  True only when native OpenCV wrote that location. Empty storage and a
   --  NaN-only matrix establish neither. Positive infinity and a stored
   --  Float32 FLT_MAX or Float64 DBL_MAX establish only the maximum, because
   --  neither is strictly less than OpenCV's initial minimum. Negative
   --  infinity and a stored -FLT_MAX or -DBL_MAX establish only the minimum.
   --  A side that was not established returns 0.0 and an all-zero location;
   --  the native initialization sentinels are not public extrema. Each
   --  location is a fixed 32-coordinate array; only elements 1 .. Dimensions
   --  are meaningful, and those values are the zero-based OpenCV coordinates.
   --  The matrix is not modified. Integer, Float16, multi-channel, and
   --  unallocated layouts are rejected before the ABI call. Min_Max
   --  normalization remains unavailable.
   --  @field Has_Minimum True when Minimum and Minimum_Location were written
   --  by native OpenCV.
   --  @field Has_Maximum True when Maximum and Maximum_Location were written
   --  by native OpenCV.
   --  @field Minimum Smallest stored value found. Meaningful only when
   --  Has_Minimum is True.
   --  @field Maximum Largest stored value found. Meaningful only when
   --  Has_Maximum is True.
   --  @field Minimum_Location Zero-based coordinates of the minimum, in
   --  entries 1 .. Dimensions; remaining entries are zero. Meaningful only
   --  when Has_Minimum is True. The array has fixed capacity 32.
   --  @field Maximum_Location Zero-based coordinates of the maximum, in
   --  entries 1 .. Dimensions; remaining entries are zero. Meaningful only
   --  when Has_Maximum is True. The array has fixed capacity 32.
   --  @field Dimensions Number of matrix dimensions, which is how many
   --  leading entries of each location array are meaningful.
   type Sparse_Extrema is record
      Has_Minimum      : Boolean := False;
      Has_Maximum      : Boolean := False;
      Minimum          : Long_Float := 0.0;
      Maximum          : Long_Float := 0.0;
      Minimum_Location : Index_Array (1 .. 32) := (others => 0);
      Maximum_Location : Index_Array (1 .. 32) := (others => 0);
      Dimensions       : Natural := 0;
   end record;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Min_Max_Loc
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Finds the extrema among the stored nodes of Self; the full contract,
   --  including ties, NaN, infinities and unestablished sides, is described
   --  with Sparse_Extrema. Only stored nodes participate: missing
   --  coordinates are not created, and an explicitly stored zero is a
   --  candidate. Self is not modified.
   --  @param Self The allocated single-channel Float32 or Float64 matrix.
   --  @return The extrema and their zero-based coordinates.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised for an unallocated, multi-channel,
   --  integer or Float16 layout, or an OpenCV failure.
   function Min_Max_Loc (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Sparse_Extrema;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Clone
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns an independent deep copy of Self. Unlike Ada assignment, which
   --  shares the nodes through a distinct header, the result owns separate
   --  storage, so later writes to either matrix do not affect the other.
   --  @param Self The Sparse_Mat to copy.
   --  @return A new Sparse_Mat with independent storage.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when OpenCV reports a failure.
   function Clone (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Sparse_Mat;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Clear
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Removes every stored node while keeping the shape and element type, so
   --  every coordinate becomes missing and an allocated Sparse_Mat stays
   --  allocated. Clearing a default (unallocated) Sparse_Mat is accepted and
   --  leaves it unallocated. Other headers that share Self's nodes through
   --  assignment observe the cleared matrix as well; a Clone is unaffected.
   --  @param Self The Sparse_Mat to clear.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when OpenCV reports a failure.
   procedure Clear (Self : in out Sparse_Mat);

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Is_Allocated
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Reports whether Self has a shape and element type. A default
   --  Sparse_Mat is unallocated; one from Create or From_Dense is allocated
   --  even when it holds no nodes, and stays allocated after Clear.
   --  @param Self The Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return True when Self reports at least one dimension.
   function Is_Allocated (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Boolean;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Dimension_Count
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns the native number of dimensions: 0 for an unallocated
   --  Sparse_Mat, otherwise between 2 and 32.
   --  @param Self The Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return The dimension count.
   function Dimension_Count (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Natural;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Shape
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns every extent in native dimension order, indexed 1 ..
   --  Dimension_Count. An unallocated Sparse_Mat returns a null array.
   --  @param Self The Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return The extents of all dimensions.
   function Shape (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Dimension_Array;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Extent
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns the extent of a 1-based axis. Axis 1 is native dimension 0.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @param Axis One-based dimension, in 1 .. Dimension_Count.
   --  @return The extent of that dimension.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated or Axis is
   --  greater than Dimension_Count.
   function Extent (Self : Sparse_Mat; Axis : Positive) return Size_Coordinate;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Depth
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns the depth of each channel value. Depth is independent of the
   --  channel count, which Channels reports.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return The element depth.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated.
   function Depth (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Depth_Type;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Channels
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns the number of channels in each stored element. This counts
   --  channels, not bytes.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return The channel count.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated.
   function Channels (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Channel_Count;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Element_Size
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns the size in bytes of one complete stored element, including
   --  all of its channels (native elemSize).
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return The byte size of one element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated.
   function Element_Size (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Mat_Size;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Channel_Size
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns the size in bytes of one channel of a stored element (native
   --  elemSize1), as opposed to the complete element size.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return The byte size of one channel.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated.
   function Channel_Size (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Mat_Size;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Stored_Element_Count
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Returns the number of stored nodes (native nzcount). A stored zero
   --  counts, a missing coordinate does not, and the value is not the
   --  product of the extents. An unallocated Sparse_Mat reports 0.
   --  @param Self The Sparse_Mat to inspect.
   --  @return The number of stored nodes.
   function Stored_Element_Count (Self : Sparse_Mat) return Mat_Size;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Contains
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Reports whether a node is stored at the given coordinates, without
   --  creating one. A stored zero is contained; a missing coordinate is not.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to query.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return True when a node is stored at Indices.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated, Indices does
   --  not have exactly Dimension_Count entries, or an index is out of
   --  bounds.
   function Contains (Self : Sparse_Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return Boolean;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.name: Erase
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.signature:
--  Removes the node stored at the given coordinates, if any, so the
   --  coordinate becomes missing. Erasing a missing coordinate is not an
   --  error. Shared headers observe the removal.
   --  @param Self The allocated Sparse_Mat to modify.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Self is unallocated, Indices does
   --  not have exactly Dimension_Count entries, or an index is out of
   --  bounds.
   procedure Erase (Self : in out Sparse_Mat; Indices : Index_Array);

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Access.signature:
--  Reads the element at Indices. A missing node reads as zero and is not
   --  created.
   --  @param Image An allocated Float16 Sparse_Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The stored value with its exact bits, or zero when no node is
   --  stored there.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is unallocated or has another
   --  depth or channel count, Indices does not have exactly Dimension_Count
   --  entries, or an index is out of bounds, or OpenCV reports a failure.
   function Get
     (Image : Sparse_Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return Float16_Value;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Access.signature:
--  Stores Value at Indices, inserting the node if it is absent. The exact
   --  bit pattern of Value is stored. A zero Value is still stored as an
   --  explicit node, which then counts in Stored_Element_Count and is
   --  visited by For_Each_Stored.
   --  @param Image An allocated Float16 Sparse_Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The element value to store; its bits are kept exactly.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is unallocated or has another
   --  depth or channel count, Indices does not have exactly Dimension_Count
   --  entries, or an index is out of bounds, or OpenCV reports a failure.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Sparse_Mat; Indices : Index_Array; Value : Float16_Value);

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Access.name: For_Each_Stored
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Access.signature:
--  Stored nodes only; unspecified order; exact binary16 bits.
   --  Do not structurally mutate Image or aliases during callbacks. Indices
   --  are zero-based with bounds 1 .. Dimension_Count. The values passed to
   --  Process are copies.
   --  @param Image An allocated Float16 Sparse_Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Process Callback invoked once for each stored node, including
   --  explicitly stored zeros, with that node's coordinates and value.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised before any callback when Image is
   --  unallocated or has another depth or channel count, and also raised if
   --  the native iteration fails, which can happen after earlier callbacks
   --  have already run.
   procedure For_Each_Stored
     (Image   : Sparse_Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure
          (Indices : Index_Array; Value : Float16_Value));

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec2_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Missing nodes read as an all-zero vector and are not created.
   --  @param Image An allocated Float16 Sparse_Mat with exactly two
   --  channels.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The stored vector with its exact bits, or an all-zero vector
   --  when no node is stored there.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is unallocated or has another
   --  depth or channel count, Indices does not have exactly Dimension_Count
   --  entries, or an index is out of bounds, or OpenCV reports a failure.
   function Get
     (Image : Sparse_Mat; Indices : Index_Array)
      return OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec2_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Inserts the node if absent; an all-zero vector is still stored.
   --  Both channels are stored together, with their exact bits.
   --  @param Image An allocated Float16 Sparse_Mat with exactly two
   --  channels.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The two channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is unallocated or has another
   --  depth or channel count, Indices does not have exactly Dimension_Count
   --  entries, or an index is out of bounds, or OpenCV reports a failure.
   procedure Set
     (Image   : in out Sparse_Mat;
      Indices : Index_Array;
      Value   : OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec2.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec2_Access.name: For_Each_Stored
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Stored nodes only; unspecified order; values are copies.
   --  Do not structurally mutate Image or aliases during callbacks.
   --  Indices have bounds 1 .. Dimension_Count and are zero-based.
   --  @param Image An allocated Float16 Sparse_Mat with exactly two
   --  channels.
   --  @param Process Callback invoked once for each stored node, including
   --  explicitly stored all-zero vectors, with that node's coordinates and
   --  value.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised before any callback when Image is
   --  unallocated or has another depth or channel count, and also raised if
   --  the native iteration fails, which can happen after earlier callbacks
   --  have already run.
   procedure For_Each_Stored
     (Image   : Sparse_Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure
          (Indices : Index_Array; Value : OpenCV.Core.Float16_Vec2.Vector));

OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec3_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.Sparse.Float16_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Missing nodes read as an all-zero vector and are not created.
   --  @param Image An allocated Float16 Sparse_Mat with exactly three
   --  channels.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The stored vector with its exact bits, or an all-zero vector
   --  when no node is stored there.
