OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.signature:
--  Reads the element at a zero-based row and column of a two-dimensional
   --  Mat.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The stored element value.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 single-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return UInt16_Value;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.signature:
--  Writes the element at a zero-based row and column of a two-dimensional
   --  Mat. The change is made in the Mat's actual storage and is visible
   --  through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @param Value The element value to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 single-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Row, Column : Integer; Value : UInt16_Value);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional access. Indices'Length must equal
   --  Image.Dimension_Count. Iteration order maps to OpenCV dimensions
   --  regardless of the array's index bounds.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The stored element value.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 single-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return UInt16_Value;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write; the indexing rules of the matching Get
   --  apply. The change is made in the Mat's actual storage and is visible
   --  through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The element value to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 single-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Indices : Index_Array; Value : UInt16_Value);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Buffer_Access.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  The flat element buffer of a Mat: one UInt16_Value per Mat element, in
   --  OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying fastest. For a
   --  nonempty Mat the callbacks pass arrays whose bounds are
   --  0 .. Natural (Image.Total) - 1.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Value;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of a continuous UInt16 C1
   --  Mat of any dimension count; genuine N-D Mats are supported.
   --  Data directly aliases native OpenCV storage for the entire
   --  logical buffer; no pixel values are copied. The explicitly
   --  aliased callback formal guarantees that Data is passed by
   --  reference and directly denotes the borrowed Mat for the duration
   --  of Process. The ordinary lifetime of the view is the callback.
   --  Data is one flat array of Mat elements in OpenCV element order,
   --  final dimension varying fastest. For a nonempty
   --  buffer, Data'First = 0, Data'Last = Natural (Image.Total) - 1, and
   --  Data'Length = Natural (Image.Total). For Shape (D1, ..., Dn),
   --  zero-based index (I1, ..., In) is Data offset
   --  ((I1 * D2 + I2) * D3 + ...) * Dn + In. For a 2-D Mat, element
   --  Data (Row * Image.Columns + Column) denotes Image (Row, Column).
   --  A correctly typed empty Mat still invokes Process once. Its array
   --  has Data'Length = 0 and the null range 1 .. 0, so no element may
   --  be indexed.
   --  There are no row separators, padding, or gaps. Image must be
   --  continuous (Is_Continuous); a nonempty non-continuous Mat, such
   --  as a gapped Region or Slice, raises OpenCV_Error before Process
   --  is invoked. A continuous Region or N-D Slice is accepted even
   --  when it is a submatrix. The implementation holds one shallow Mat
   --  lease for the callback so referenced storage cannot disappear
   --  merely because another header is rebound or finalized. That lease
   --  is deterministic memory management, not thread synchronization.
   --  Do not retain a reference or address of Data after Process
   --  returns. Read-only access performs no copy; if another alias
   --  mutates the shared storage during the callback, Data observes
   --  those changes according to ordinary aliasing rules.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 single-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, including the nonempty zero-based range
   --  and the empty 1 .. 0 null range, except Process receives an in-out
   --  view.
   --  Writes through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  There is no write-back phase. A write through Data is visible
   --  through Image and any shallow alias before Process returns, and
   --  a write through another alias is immediately visible through
   --  Data. Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged; any
   --  writes completed before the exception remain visible.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 single-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of UInt16_Value elements supplied by the caller. Its
   --  index bounds are the caller's choice: only Data'First (the first
   --  element) and Data'Length (the capacity) are used, and the lower bound
   --  is not exposed through the Mat.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Value;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC1 Mat that aliases
   --  Data. Image (0, 0) is Data (Data'First), and row-major element Image
   --  (Row, Column) is Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column).
   --  Data'Length must equal Rows * Columns. The Ada lower bound is not
   --  exposed through the Mat. Image is valid only during Process and must
   --  not be retained. Ordinary shallow copies and views are rejected
   --  because they would share the caller-owned buffer after Process returns.
   --  Clone is the supported way to keep an independent Mat. Writes through
   --  Image immediately modify Data, and writes through Data immediately
   --  affect Image. The temporary cv::Mat header does not own or copy Data.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image, within the native signed
   --  32-bit range.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image, within the native
   --  signed 32-bit range.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows    : Positive;
      Columns : Positive;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC1 Mat that aliases Data. Shape'Length must be in 2 .. 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) and
   --  every extent must be positive; Shape iteration order maps directly to
   --  OpenCV dimension order regardless of Shape'First. Data'Length must
   --  equal product (Shape) exactly. Storage is packed and continuous with
   --  the final dimension varying fastest: zero-based index (I1, .., In)
   --  is Data (Data'First + ((I1 * D2 + I2) * D3 + ..) * Dn + In). Neither
   --  Ada lower bound is exposed through the Mat. Shape => (Rows, Columns)
   --  has the same geometry as the Rows/Columns overload. No data is
   --  copied and the caller retains ownership. Callback lifetime and escape
   --  rules are identical to the Rows/Columns overload: shallow copies,
   --  Slice, and Reshape are rejected; Clone is the independent escape path.
   --  Gapped N-D storage uses With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View (Shape,
   --  Strides).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC1 Mat that aliases
   --  Data with Row_Stride UInt16 elements between logical row starts.
   --  Row_Stride must be at least Columns. Image (Row, Column) maps to
   --  Data (Data'First + Row * Row_Stride + Column). Data'Length must be at
   --  least Rows * Row_Stride, including padding after the final logical row.
   --  Padding and extra trailing storage are outside the logical Mat.
   --  No data is copied. Ownership, callback lifetime, and escape rules are
   --  identical to With_Writable_Mat_View; Clone is the safe escape path.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in UInt16 elements, between the starts of
   --  consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data       : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows       : Positive;
      Columns    : Positive;
      Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process    : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable strided N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC1 Mat that aliases Data. Shape'Length must be in 2 .. 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) with
   --  positive extents, and Strides supplies exactly one stride per
   --  dimension in the same order; neither array's index bounds matter.
   --  Strides count complete UInt16 elements, not bytes. The final stride
   --  must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner block:
   --  Strides (I) >= Strides (I + 1) * Shape (I + 1), so layouts never
   --  overlap or run backwards. Zero-based index (I1, .., In) is
   --  Data (Data'First + I1 * S1 + .. + In * Sn). Data'Length must be at
   --  least Shape (first) * Strides (first): the complete outer stride,
   --  including padding after the final logical outer block, is part of the
   --  native header and must exist. Extra trailing storage is allowed and is
   --  outside the header; padding is never a logical element and is not
   --  touched. Is_Continuous reports the actual layout, so packed-equivalent
   --  strides are continuous. No data is copied and the caller retains
   --  ownership. Callback lifetime and escape rules match the other
   --  overloads: shallow copies, Slice, Reshape, and output handles are
   --  rejected; Clone is the independent escape path and holds only the
   --  logical values.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Shape (first) * Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in UInt16 elements (not
   --  bytes); the final stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its
   --  nested inner block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, the two arrays differ in length, or Data
   --  is too short.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only caller-owned zero-copy views; aliased constant Data is valid.
   --  Geometry/capacity match the corresponding writable overloads above.
   --  Mode-in Image forbids normal Ada mutation (not OS page protection).
   --  Shallow escape is rejected; Clone owns pixels; module input is allowed.
   --  This overload views a packed row-major buffer; Data'Length must equal
   --  Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed N-dimensional buffer, with the geometry
   --  rules of the writable N-dimensional overload: Shape has 2 to 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0)
   --  positive extents and Data'Length equals their product. The temporary
   --  Image is valid only during the callback.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases; it may
   --  be an aliased constant.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  is invalid, has more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, or
   --  Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a two-dimensional buffer with Row_Stride UInt16
   --  elements between row starts, following the geometry and capacity rules
   --  of the writable strided overload. Padding between rows is not part of
   --  the logical Mat. The temporary Image is valid only during the callback.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in UInt16 elements, between row starts; at
   --  least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is too short, or a dimension
   --  exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a strided N-dimensional buffer, following the
   --  geometry, stride and capacity rules of the writable strided
   --  N-dimensional overload. Strides count complete UInt16 elements, not
   --  bytes. The temporary Image is valid only during the callback.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in UInt16 elements; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, or Data is too short.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.name: Column_Index
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based column position within a row.
   subtype Column_Index is Natural;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.name: Row_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.signature:
--  The values of one Mat row, one UInt16_Value per column. Array bounds
   --  are the caller's choice: only the length matters, and the first array
   --  element always corresponds to column 0. The zero-copy callbacks pass
   --  arrays whose bounds are 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   type Row_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Value;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.name: Read_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies one row of Image into Data. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) receives column 0 and the array's
   --  index bounds are otherwise irrelevant. Image is unchanged and Data
   --  owns its values.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data Receives one value per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 single-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Read_Row (Image : Mat; Row : Natural; Data : out Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.name: Write_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies Data into one row of Image. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) is stored in column 0. The values are
   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One value per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 single-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a zero-copy view of one UInt16 C1 Mat row.
   --  Data directly aliases native OpenCV storage for that logical row;
   --  no pixel values are copied. The explicitly aliased callback
   --  formal guarantees that Data is passed by reference and directly
   --  denotes the borrowed Mat row for the duration of Process. The
   --  ordinary lifetime of the view is the callback. Data is indexed
   --  with zero-based Mat columns:
   --  Data'First = 0, Data'Last = Image.Columns - 1, and Data'Length =
   --  Image.Columns. Only the active row elements are exposed, never
   --  inter-row padding. Non-contiguous Regions are supported because
   --  each 2-D logical row remains a contiguous sequence even when the
   --  parent stride is larger. The implementation holds a shallow Mat
   --  lease for the callback so referenced storage cannot disappear
   --  merely because another header is rebound or finalized. That lease
   --  is deterministic memory management, not thread synchronization.
   --  Do not retain a reference or address of Data after Process
   --  returns. Read-only access performs no copy; if another alias
   --  mutates the shared storage during the callback, Data observes
   --  those changes according to ordinary aliasing rules.
   --  Image.Is_Continuous is not required.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row. Data is valid
   --  only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional UInt16 single-channel Mat or Row is outside
   --  the Mat.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Row
     (Image   : Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.name: With_Writable_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Row_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Row, except Process receives an in-out view.
   --  Writes through Data mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  There is no write-back phase. A write through Data is visible
   --  through Image and any shallow alias before Process returns, and
   --  a write through another alias is immediately visible through
   --  Data. Exceptions raised by Process propagate unchanged; any
   --  writes completed before the exception remain visible.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly one channel.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional UInt16 single-channel Mat or Row is outside
   --  the Mat.
   procedure With_Writable_Row
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Reads the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The two channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 two-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return UInt16_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Writes the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat. Both channels are stored together, in the Mat's
   --  actual storage, and are visible through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @param Value The two channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 two-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Row, Column : Integer; Value : UInt16_Vec2.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional access. Indices'Length must equal
   --  Image.Dimension_Count. Iteration order maps to OpenCV dimensions
   --  regardless of the array's index bounds. One vector is one complete
   --  two-channel element.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The two channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 two-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return UInt16_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write of one complete two-channel element;
   --  the indexing rules of the matching Get apply. Both channels are stored
   --  together, in the Mat's actual storage, and are visible through every
   --  header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The two channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 two-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Indices : Index_Array; Value : UInt16_Vec2.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Buffer_Access.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  The flat element buffer of a Mat: one UInt16_Vec2.Vector per Mat
   --  element, in OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying
   --  fastest.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  Each entry is one complete C2 element; borrow is callback-scoped.
   --  Data is a flat array of all Mat elements, in OpenCV element order with
   --  the final dimension varying fastest. A shallow lease retains storage
   --  until Process returns. An empty Mat of the right type is accepted.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 two-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except Process receives an in-out view whose
   --  writes mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 two-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of UInt16_Vec2.Vector elements supplied by the caller.
   --  Only Data'First (the first element) and Data'Length (the capacity, in
   --  complete pixels) are used.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Vec2.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Strides count complete vectors. Shallow escape is prohibited;
   --  Clone may escape.
   --  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC2 Mat that aliases
   --  Data in row-major order: Image (Row, Column) is
   --  Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC2 Mat that aliases Data; the final dimension varies fastest.
   --  Shape shall have 2 to 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) positive extents and Data'Length shall equal
   --  their product.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC2 Mat that aliases
   --  Data with Row_Stride complete pixels between logical row starts.
   --  Row_Stride must be at least Columns and Data must hold at least
   --  Rows * Row_Stride pixels, including padding after the final row.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between the starts of
   --  consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   :
        not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable strided N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC2 Mat that aliases Data. Strides count complete pixels, not
   --  bytes; the final stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its
   --  nested inner block.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Shape (first) * Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, the two arrays differ in length, or Data
   --  is too short.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed row-major buffer. Data may be an aliased
   --  constant; the geometry follows the writable Rows/Columns overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed N-dimensional buffer, with the geometry
   --  rules of the writable N-dimensional overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases; it may
   --  be an aliased constant.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  is invalid, has more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, or
   --  Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a two-dimensional buffer with Row_Stride complete
   --  pixels between row starts, following the rules of the writable strided
   --  overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between row starts; at
   --  least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is too short, or a dimension
   --  exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a strided N-dimensional buffer, following the
   --  geometry, stride and capacity rules of the writable strided
   --  N-dimensional overload. Strides count complete pixels, not bytes.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, or Data is too short.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.name: Row_Array
Read_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies one row of Image into Data. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) receives column 0. Image is unchanged
   --  and Data owns its values.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data Receives one two-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 two-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Read_Row (Image : Mat; Row : Natural; Data : out Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.name: Write_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies Data into one row of Image. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) is stored in column 0. The values are
   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One two-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 two-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  Callback-scoped, zero-copy access to one row. Data aliases the native
   --  storage of that row (one complete two-channel pixel per element) and is
   --  valid only during Process; a shallow Mat lease keeps the storage alive
   --  for the callback.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row. Data is valid
   --  only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional UInt16 two-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Row
     (Image   : Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.name: With_Writable_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec2_Row_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Row, except Process receives an in-out view whose
   --  writes mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly two channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional UInt16 two-channel Mat or Row is outside the
   --  Mat.
   procedure With_Writable_Row
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Reads the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The three channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 three-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return UInt16_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Writes the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat. All three channels are stored together, in the
   --  Mat's actual storage, and are visible through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @param Value The three channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 three-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Row, Column : Integer; Value : UInt16_Vec3.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional access. Indices'Length must equal
   --  Image.Dimension_Count. Iteration order maps to OpenCV dimensions
   --  regardless of the array's index bounds. One vector is one complete
   --  three-channel element.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The three channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 three-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return UInt16_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write of one complete three-channel element;
   --  the indexing rules of the matching Get apply. All three channels are
   --  stored together, in the Mat's actual storage, and are visible through
   --  every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The three channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 three-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Indices : Index_Array; Value : UInt16_Vec3.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Buffer_Access.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  The flat element buffer of a Mat: one UInt16_Vec3.Vector per Mat
   --  element, in OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying
   --  fastest.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  One entry per complete C3 element of a continuous Mat.
   --  Data is a flat array of all Mat elements, in OpenCV element order with
   --  the final dimension varying fastest. The view is callback-scoped and a
   --  shallow lease retains storage until Process returns. An empty Mat of
   --  the right type is accepted.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 three-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except Process receives an in-out view whose
   --  writes mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 three-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of UInt16_Vec3.Vector elements supplied by the caller.
   --  Only Data'First (the first element) and Data'Length (the capacity, in
   --  complete pixels) are used.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Vec3.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Callback-scoped caller-owned storage; one entry per complete C3 element.
   --  Shallow Mat escape is prohibited; Clone owns independent storage.
   --  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC3 Mat that aliases
   --  Data in row-major order: Image (Row, Column) is
   --  Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC3 Mat that aliases Data; the final dimension varies fastest.
   --  Shape shall have 2 to 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) positive extents and Data'Length shall equal
   --  their product.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC3 Mat that aliases
   --  Data with Row_Stride complete pixels between logical row starts.
   --  Row_Stride must be at least Columns and Data must hold at least
   --  Rows * Row_Stride pixels, including padding after the final row.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between the starts of
   --  consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   :
        not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable strided N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC3 Mat that aliases Data. Strides count complete pixels, not
   --  bytes; the final stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its
   --  nested inner block.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Shape (first) * Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, the two arrays differ in length, or Data
   --  is too short.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only overloads accept aliased constant storage.
   --  Read-only view of a packed row-major buffer; the geometry follows the
   --  writable Rows/Columns overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed N-dimensional buffer, with the geometry
   --  rules of the writable N-dimensional overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases; it may
   --  be an aliased constant.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  is invalid, has more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, or
   --  Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a two-dimensional buffer with Row_Stride complete
   --  pixels between row starts, following the rules of the writable strided
   --  overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between row starts; at
   --  least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is too short, or a dimension
   --  exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a strided N-dimensional buffer, following the
   --  geometry, stride and capacity rules of the writable strided
   --  N-dimensional overload. Strides count complete pixels, not bytes.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, or Data is too short.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.name: Row_Array
Read_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies one row of Image into Data. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) receives column 0. Image is unchanged
   --  and Data owns its values.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data Receives one three-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 three-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   --  Also raised when Data'Length exceeds Natural'Last / 3: copied rows
   --  use an intermediate buffer of three scalar channels per vector.
   --  This limit does not apply to the zero-copy row callbacks.
   procedure Read_Row (Image : Mat; Row : Natural; Data : out Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.name: Write_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies Data into one row of Image. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) is stored in column 0. The values are
   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One three-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 three-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   --  Also raised when Data'Length exceeds Natural'Last / 3: copied rows
   --  use an intermediate buffer of three scalar channels per vector.
   --  This limit does not apply to the zero-copy row callbacks.
   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.signature:
--  Callback-scoped, zero-copy row access with a shallow storage lease.
   --  Data aliases the native storage of that row (one complete
   --  three-channel pixel per element) and is valid only during Process.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row. Data is valid
   --  only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional UInt16 three-channel Mat or Row is outside
   --  the Mat.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Row
     (Image   : Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.name: With_Writable_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec3_Row_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Row, except Process receives an in-out view whose
   --  writes mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly three channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed row for reading and
   --  writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a two-dimensional UInt16 three-channel Mat or Row is outside
   --  the Mat.
   procedure With_Writable_Row
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Row     : Natural;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Row_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Reads the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @return The four channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 four-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Row, Column : Integer) return UInt16_Vec4.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Writes the complete element at a zero-based row and column of a
   --  two-dimensional Mat. All four channels are stored together, in the
   --  Mat's actual storage, and are visible through every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Column Zero-based column, in 0 .. Image.Columns - 1.
   --  @param Value The four channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 four-channel
   --  two-dimensional Mat, or Row or Column is outside the Mat.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Row, Column : Integer; Value : UInt16_Vec4.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.name: Get
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional access. Indices'Length must equal
   --  Image.Dimension_Count. Iteration order maps to OpenCV dimensions
   --  regardless of the array's index bounds. One vector is one complete
   --  four-channel element.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @return The four channel values of the element.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 four-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   function Get (Image : Mat; Indices : Index_Array) return UInt16_Vec4.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.name: Set
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Access.signature:
--  Zero-based N-dimensional write of one complete four-channel element;
   --  the indexing rules of the matching Get apply. All four channels are
   --  stored together, in the Mat's actual storage, and are visible through
   --  every header sharing it.
   --  @param Image A UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels and at least one
   --  dimension.
   --  @param Indices One zero-based index per dimension, each less than the
   --  matching extent.
   --  @param Value The four channel values to store.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 four-channel
   --  Mat, Indices does not have exactly one entry per dimension, or an
   --  index is out of range.
   procedure Set
     (Image : in out Mat; Indices : Index_Array; Value : UInt16_Vec4.Vector);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  The flat element buffer of a Mat: one UInt16_Vec4.Vector per Mat
   --  element, in OpenCV element order with the final dimension varying
   --  fastest.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Vec4.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  Continuous Mats only; one entry per complete C4 element.
   --  A shallow lease retains storage until Process returns. Data is a flat
   --  array of all Mat elements, in OpenCV element order with the final
   --  dimension varying fastest. An empty Mat of the right type is accepted.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer. Data is
   --  valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 four-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Buffer
     (Image   : Mat;
      Process : not null access procedure (Data : aliased Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.name: With_Writable_Buffer
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Buffer_Access.signature:
--  As With_Read_Only_Buffer, except Process receives an in-out view whose
   --  writes mutate the actual Mat storage immediately.
   --  @param Image A continuous UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the borrowed buffer for reading
   --  and writing. Data is valid only during the call and must not be
   --  retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Image
   --  is not a UInt16 four-channel Mat or is nonempty and not continuous,
   --  or has more elements than Natural'Last.
   procedure With_Writable_Buffer
     (Image   : in out Mat;
      Process :
        not null access procedure (Data : aliased in out Buffer_Array));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: Buffer_Array
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  A flat buffer of UInt16_Vec4.Vector elements supplied by the caller.
   --  Only Data'First (the first element) and Data'Length (the capacity, in
   --  complete pixels) are used.
   type Buffer_Array is array (Natural range <>) of UInt16_Vec4.Vector;

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Caller owns storage; strides count complete vectors. Shallow views
   --  cannot escape the callback; Clone creates independent storage.
   --  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC4 Mat that aliases
   --  Data in row-major order: Image (Row, Column) is
   --  Data (Data'First + Row * Columns + Column).
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable packed N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC4 Mat that aliases Data; the final dimension varies fastest.
   --  Shape shall have 2 to 32
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0) positive extents and Data'Length shall equal
   --  their product.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases, passed
   --  by reference; its length must equal the product of Shape.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0), in OpenCV dimension order.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  has fewer than 2 or more than 32 dimensions (more than 10 on OpenCV
   --  5.0), more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, an extent is
   --  zero, or Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Writable_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable CV_16UC4 Mat that aliases
   --  Data with Row_Stride complete pixels between logical row starts.
   --  Row_Stride must be at least Columns and Data must hold at least
   --  Rows * Row_Stride pixels, including padding after the final row.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between the starts of
   --  consecutive rows; at least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is shorter than Rows *
   --  Row_Stride, or a dimension exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   :
        not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Invokes Process with a temporary writable strided N-dimensional
   --  CV_16UC4 Mat that aliases Data. Strides count complete pixels, not
   --  bytes; the final stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its
   --  nested inner block.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases, passed by
   --  reference; its length must be at least Shape (first) * Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary writable Image. It
   --  is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, the two arrays differ in length, or Data
   --  is too short.
   procedure With_Writable_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased in out Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : in out Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Mode-in callback preserves the read-only Ada capability boundary.
   --  Read-only view of a packed row-major buffer; Data may be an aliased
   --  constant and the geometry follows the writable Rows/Columns overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be Rows * Columns.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Data'Length differs from Rows * Columns or a dimension exceeds the
   --  native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data          : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns : Positive;
      Process       : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a packed N-dimensional buffer, with the geometry
   --  rules of the writable N-dimensional overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned packed buffer that Image aliases; it may
   --  be an aliased constant.
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  is invalid, has more dimensions than the linked OpenCV supports, or
   --  Data'Length differs from the product of Shape.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a two-dimensional buffer with Row_Stride complete
   --  pixels between row starts, following the rules of the writable strided
   --  overload.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Rows * Row_Stride.
   --  @param Rows Positive row count of Image.
   --  @param Columns Positive column count of Image.
   --  @param Row_Stride Distance, in complete pixels, between row starts; at
   --  least Columns.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when
   --  Row_Stride is less than Columns, Data is too short, or a dimension
   --  exceeds the native range.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data                      : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Rows, Columns, Row_Stride : Positive;
      Process                   : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.name: With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Mat_View.signature:
--  Read-only view of a strided N-dimensional buffer, following the
   --  geometry, stride and capacity rules of the writable strided
   --  N-dimensional overload. Strides count complete pixels, not bytes.
   --  @param Data The caller-owned buffer that Image aliases; it may be an
   --  aliased constant. Its length must be at least Shape (first) *
   --  Strides (first).
   --  @param Shape Extent of each dimension, 2 to 32 positive values
   --  (at most 10 on OpenCV 5.0).
   --  @param Strides One stride per dimension, in complete pixels; the final
   --  stride must be 1 and each outer stride must cover its nested inner
   --  block.
   --  @param Process Callback that receives the temporary read-only Image.
   --  It is valid only during the call and must not be retained.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised, before Process is invoked, when Shape
   --  or Strides violates the rules above, Shape has more dimensions than
   --  the linked OpenCV supports, or Data is too short.
   procedure With_Read_Only_Strided_Mat_View
     (Data    : aliased Buffer_Array;
      Shape   : Dimension_Array;
      Strides : Dimension_Stride_Array;
      Process : not null access procedure (Image : Mat));

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: Row_Array
Read_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies one row of Image into Data. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) receives column 0. Image is unchanged
   --  and Data owns its values.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data Receives one four-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 four-channel
   --  Mat, Row is outside the Mat, or Data'Length differs from
   --  Image.Columns.
   procedure Read_Row (Image : Mat; Row : Natural; Data : out Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: Write_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
--  Copies Data into one row of Image. Data'Length must equal
   --  Image.Columns; Data (Data'First) is stored in column 0. The values are
   --  written to the Mat's actual storage, so shallow aliases and the parent
   --  of a Region observe them.
   --  @param Image A two-dimensional UInt16 Mat with exactly four channels.
   --  @param Row Zero-based row, in 0 .. Image.Rows - 1.
   --  @param Data One four-channel pixel per column.
   --  @exception OpenCV_Error Raised when Image is not a UInt16 four-channel

   procedure Write_Row (Image : in out Mat; Row : Natural; Data : Row_Array);

OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Row_Access.name: With_Read_Only_Row
OpenCV.Core.UInt16_Vec4_Row_Access.signature:
